title: List the required pair missed by the interval recurrence
body:
## Summary
- The fixed-cover correction has 4,992 required pairs. The eight-layer interval recurrence reaches 4,991 of them.
- The only missing pair is target 71 from source 102. Its matrix entry is `-4`, so the coefficient is `-1/2`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The literal quotient engine is not run.
